How life expectancy change over time for each continent?
Life expectancy for a country is the mean length of life over people of a country. Using variables life expectancy and population of a country:


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# cache results
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache=TRUE, echo = TRUE, eval = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align='center')
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(gapminder)
library(broom)
```

derive a formula to compute life expectancy of a continent (a group of countries)


$$
\text{lifeExp}_{continent} = \frac{\sum_i \text{lifeExp}_i \cdot \text{population}_i}{\sum_i \text{population}_i}
$$

plot how life expectancy changed over time for each continent
```{r}
continents <- gapminder |>
  mutate(pop = as.numeric(pop)) |>
  group_by(continent, year) |>
  summarise(lifeExp = sum(lifeExp * pop) / sum(pop))

ggplot(data = continents) +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = year, y = lifeExp, color = continent)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Life expectancy")
```

do the same for the whole planet

```{r}
world <- gapminder |>
  mutate(pop = as.numeric(pop)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(lifeExp = sum(lifeExp * pop) / sum(pop))
  
ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = year, y = lifeExp)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Life expectancy")
```
